description: Build a public cart link after the buyer has chosen products. Returns the link and the selected IDs, omitting standalone mods already included in the selected Foundation Kit. Unknown or duplicate IDs return an error. The buyer can review the cart before signing in and confirming the final total and payment at checkout.

productIds.description: Distinct listed product IDs from search_catalog. Include each ID once.

items.description: Lowercase product ID from search_catalog, such as "funnel" or "foundation-kit" when listed.
